metadata.title: Dedicated Access Workstation (DAW) macOS SSPP
metadata.remarks: Operating system–specific System Security and Privacy Plan defining how Apple macOS endpoints implement the Dedicated Access Workstation (DAW) trust tier.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: An Apple macOS Dedicated Access Workstation configured as a single-purpose, maximal-assurance execution environment for privileged access and Level 4 data workflows.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: This macOS SSPP inherits all DAW requirements, including all COBO L2 and COBO L1 inherited constraints.

props.name: supported-versions
props.remarks: Only the current, vendor-supported macOS release approved for DAW use is permitted.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: DAW macOS endpoint is owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: DAW macOS endpoint is centrally enrolled, governed, and monitored using institutional MDM services.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: General productivity workloads (email, web browsing, messaging, collaboration, office applications) are prohibited on DAW macOS endpoints.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: macOS DAW identity must use Secure Enclave–backed non-exportable private keys, PKI-issued device certificates, and support hardware-backed attestation.

props.name: cryptographic-compliance
props.remarks: macOS cryptographic operations must rely on platform cryptographic services operating in FIPS 140-3 validated modes where applicable.

props.name: secure-boot-and-platform-integrity
props.remarks: Apple Secure Boot, sealed system volume, and platform integrity protections must be enabled and enforced.

props.name: system-integrity-protection
props.remarks: System Integrity Protection (SIP) must be enabled at the strictest supported configuration.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: macOS DAW configuration applies CIS macOS Benchmark Level 2 with additional DAW-specific hardening overlays.

props.name: credential-and-secret-protection
props.remarks: Credentials and secrets must be confined to Secure Enclave–backed Keychain with restricted access policies.

props.name: malware-and-threat-protection
props.remarks: Apple XProtect, Gatekeeper, notarization enforcement, and institution-approved advanced endpoint threat protection must be enabled.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: DAW macOS endpoints may communicate only with approved administrative brokers, management services, and control planes.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: DAW macOS endpoints are required for workflows involving Level 4 data.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: DAW endpoint status does not confer automatic entitlement to Level 4 data; all access remains governed by Secure Data policies.

props.name: privileged-workloads-only
props.remarks: DAW macOS endpoints are limited to privileged administration and high-risk institutional workflows.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Enrollment, suspension, recovery, and retirement of DAW macOS endpoints require elevated approval and enhanced auditability.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines how macOS implements the DAW trust tier using Apple hardware security features, strict configuration baselines, strong cryptographic identity, and continuous posture assurance.

control-implementation.remarks: macOS configuration profiles, MDM enforcement, CIS Level 2 baselines, notarization controls, and endpoint protection tooling implement this SSPP and are maintained as strictly controlled, versioned artifacts.
